author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a figure with a ring head leaning into a sweep, front arm on a diagonal broom handle ending in a flat oval broom head on the ice, back arm bent out, legs apart; reads as a curling sweeper. The rejected drawing had a small dot-like head and crowded limbs.
omissions: The reference's outlined body is reduced to a stick figure; head gap exactly 8 on centerlines (vertical, certified).
